crossRefs.note: There is a grievous evil which I have seen under the sun: wealth kept by its owner to his harm.

translations.web: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is heavy on men:
translations.bsb: There is another evil I have seen under the sun, and it weighs heavily upon mankind:
translations.kjv: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is common among men:
translations.asv: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is heavy upon men:
